title: A differential federated learning method for abnormal power consumption identification based on updated contribution weighted aggregation

pse.problem: The existing methods for identifying abnormal power consumption have dependencies on data concentration, risk of data leakage during transmission, and do not consider differences in client contributions to global model updates which affects efficiency.
pse.solution_function: Differential federated learning method with updated contribution weighted aggregation identifies abnormal power consumption behavior by local training, generating noise perturbation gradients, calculating global contribution, aggregating gradients according to the weighted average criterion of the global contribution, and updating the global model.
pse.solution_structure: The solution comprises distributed federated learning identification model, local monitoring client, and central server.
pse.solution_implementation: Local clients collect, pre-process electricity consumption information; local training generates noise perturbation gradients; central server calculates global contribution, aggregates gradients using weighted average criterion of the global contribution, updates the global model; global model identifies abnormal power consumption behavior and records identification results.
pse.effect: Improves operation and maintenance efficiency of the power distribution network and secures distribution network data by considering privacy protection during training process.
